message_text: Principal messaged: pickup yr 6 students from west gate by 4pm—drill ended early, not a lockdown.
scenario_rationale: School coordination after a safety drill; no threat or payment demand from sender.

message_text: Has anyone seen my nana since yesterday evening near the temporary shelter? Grey cap, walks slowly—just worried, not accusing staff.
scenario_rationale: Missing-family welfare check without intimidation or fraud.

message_text: Night shelter at parish hall has mats and tea; sign in at desk. No fee, bring your own blanket if you can.
scenario_rationale: Legitimate shelter logistics; voluntary donation only.

message_text: Police escorted the water tanker through—thank you, that was urgent for block C.
scenario_rationale: Thanks to police for logistics; sender is not issuing a threat.

message_text: Warning on radio was about heatstroke risk, not telling us to pay anyone. Drink water, stay indoors noon–3.
We're collecting money for generator fuel at the lane committee—optional, receipt notebook at table 2.
Share-auto stand moved to cinema junction because of rubble on old lane—helpful if you're heading to the clinic.
school gate?? kids still inside?? call me
scenario_rationale: Fragmented urgent parent message; help request without misconduct.

message_text: Volunteer boat team needs 2 strong arms at slipway 3 at dawn—food provided, no pay required.
This humidity is murder on the toddlers—any spare ORS packets at the creche corner?
Looks like a county notice screenshot: coastal highway shut near km 42 for crane work till Friday—take inland route 9.
scenario_rationale: Traffic diversion info; sender shares notice, not impersonating for payment.

message_text: Met office tweet says squall line tonight; tie down tarps. Not an evacuation order.
Water board IVR says low pressure 6–9 am in zone F—fill buckets tonight if you can.
Forwarded PDF header says 'collector office' about curfew—font looks odd, can anyone confirm on landline?
scenario_rationale: Uncertain authenticity of official-looking doc; needs human review.

message_text: Pay what you can at the kitchen if you want extra rice—zero is fine for tonight.
scenario_rationale: Optional pay phrasing; not extortion (contrast CH2-EN-25).

message_text: Neighbour says someone in orange vest demanded cash to 'approve' tarp slots—flagging for camp admin, I didn't pay.
scenario_rationale: Reporting alleged misconduct by another party.

message_text: She told me he yelled 'I'll break your legs if you queue here' by the pump—repeating her words for the logbook.
scenario_rationale: Quoted third-party threat; sender reports, not threatening.

message_text: That viral voice note claiming the dam burst is old audio from 2019—please stop forwarding.
Someone might be selling spots in the medic line but I only heard gossip, no names.
News clip transcript includes 'stay indoors or face consequences' from the mayor's presser—sharing excerpt.
scenario_rationale: Quoted official/historical statement in media context.

message_text: Keep your kids away from my tent or you'll be sorry tonight.
scenario_rationale: Direct intimidation from sender toward recipient.

message_text: Pay 300 cash now or you sleep outside the fence—I'm not asking twice.
scenario_rationale: Coercive payment demand tied to shelter access.

message_text: Disaster compensation unit: wire 'verification tax' to unlock your grant within 30 minutes.
scenario_rationale: Fake official payment demand; impersonation/fraud pattern.

message_text: I'm relief logistics—send Aadhaar PDF and card photo on WhatsApp to reserve today's food crate.
scenario_rationale: Credential harvesting posing as relief worker.

message_text: You pay 300 now or you sleep outside—no exceptions.
Stop snitching to security or we will find you after lights out.
help money police??? idk which chat is real
टीचर ने लिखा: बच्चों को ४ बजे पूर्वी गेट से ले जाएँ, अभ्यास खत्म—धमकी नहीं, सूचना है।
मोबाइल क्लिनिक में बुखार की दवा मुफ्त है, पर्ची लाएँ। कोई शुल्क नहीं।
पुलिस ने भीड़ हटाकर एम्बुलेंस का रास्ता खुलवाया—शुक्रिया, जरूरी था।
scenario_rationale: पुलिस का सहयोग; प्रेषक धमकी नहीं दे रहा।

message_text: चेतावनी केवल लू से बचाव के लिए थी, पैसे मांगने के लिए नहीं।
क्या कोई ने मेरी माँ को शरण केंद्र की ओर जाते देखा? चिंता है, आरोप नहीं।
जिला सड़क विभाग: पहाड़ी मोड़ पर मरम्मत—वैकल्पिक मार्ग १२ से जाएँ, देरी संभव।
बिजली कटौती कल १०–१२ बजे वार्ड ५ में नियोजित है।
फॉरवर्ड किया गया 'जिलाधिकारी' नोटिस—लेटरहेड अजीब लग रहा, क्या कोई लैंडलाइन से पुष्टि करे?
पड़ोसी बोल रहे किसी ने नकली राहत फीस मांगी—मैंने नहीं दी, प्रशासन को बताना चाहता हूँ।
scenario_rationale: दूसरों के कथित कपट की रिपोर्ट।

message_text: गवाह ने कहा उसने चिल्लाया 'पैसे दो वरना तंबू जला दूँगा'—मैं उद्धरण दर्ज कर रहा हूँ।
scenario_rationale: उद्धृत धमकी, प्रेषक की अपनी धमकी नहीं।

message_text: वायरल मैसेज कि बांध टूटा है पुराना है—कृपया दोबारा न भेजें।
शायद कोई कतार में जगह बेच रहा है, पक्का सुनिश्चित नहीं।
अभी ५०० रुपये दो नहीं तो आज रात खाने की लाइन में नहीं लगने दूँगा।
राहत विभाग: अनुदान के लिए OTP भेजें और कार्ड की फोटो शेयर करें—तत्काल।
फिर शिकायत की तो देख लेंगे, चुपचाप रहो।
स्वयंसेवक चाहिए खाने के पैकेट बांटने के लिए—सुबह ७ बजे मैदान में, भोजन मिलेगा।
यह गर्मी बच्चों पर भारी पड़ रही है—कोई पंखा उधार दे सकता है?
मदद??? पुलिस??? पैसा??? समझ नहीं आया

इंसुलिन के लिए कुछ रुपये उधार चाहिए शुक्रवार तक—धमकी नहीं, संपर्क करें।

Central relief desk here—your name flagged unless you immediate transfer clearance fee.
scenario_rationale: Impersonated authority demanding fee (fraud not mere threat).
